metabolic_screening.label: Newborn Metabolic Screening (blood spot / PKU)
metabolic_screening.program: Connecticut Department of Public Health â Newborn Screening Program
metabolic_screening.state_form_note: CT has a standalone Newborn Screening Refusal Waiver Form. Religious exemption available. All babies born in CT automatically receive bloodspot screening; parent can say no if it conflicts with religious beliefs. Signed waiver sent to DPH; result entered in NSS; PCP notified.
metabolic_screening.kit_ordering_note: NBS collection supplies requested via CT DPH forms page; specimens shipped to CT Public Health Laboratory.
metabolic_screening.specimen_tracking_note: NBS tracking via NSS (Newborn Screening System); midwives verify specimen receipt.
metabolic_screening.midwife_role: Complete TRF 12â48h after birth, give refusal waiver to parents if declining, send specimen+TRF to CT lab, enter result in NSS.
metabolic_screening.declination_law: CT General Statutes Â§19a-55 â religious exemption available; refusal waiver form required.

billing.note: Parents are billed directly; most insurance covers screening; midwife is NOT billed for the screening test itself.

hearing_screening.label: Newborn Hearing Screening
hearing_screening.program: Connecticut Early Hearing Detection and Intervention (EHDI) Program
hearing_screening.state_form_note: Hearing screening refusal uses the same Newborn Screening Refusal Waiver Form. CT requires hearing screening before discharge; refusal documented on waiver form and sent to DPH.
hearing_screening.midwife_role: Educate parents; if opted-in, refer to EHDI-approved audiologist; if declined, document refusal on waiver form.

cchd_screening.label: CCHD Pulse Oximetry Screening (critical congenital heart disease)
cchd_screening.state_form_note: CCHD screening refusal uses the same Newborn Screening Refusal Waiver Form. Pulse ox performed at bedside; refusal documented on waiver.
cchd_screening.midwife_role: Perform or refer for pulse-ox screening; document refusal on waiver form if declined.

erythromycin_eye_ointment.label: Erythromycin Eye Ointment (newborn eye prophylaxis)
erythromycin_eye_ointment.state_form_note: Eye prophylaxis is a standard of care; no standalone state declination form â practice standard is a signed informed-refusal/waiver document (app master form).
erythromycin_eye_ointment.midwife_role: If opted-in: administer erythromycin within 2h of birth. If declined: signed informed refusal (in-app master form) retained in records.

vitamin_k.midwife_role: Three-way informed choice (oral / shot / none) documented in-app; shot administered by midwife or referred.

hepatitis_b_vaccine.label: Hepatitis B Vaccine (birth dose)
hepatitis_b_vaccine.midwife_role: Birth-dose consent or declination documented in writing; administered dose reported to CTIR.
